title: Storage Fee Billing for Units Held at the Branch Warehouse
content:
**Rule.** Under Factory Production Orders, delivered units kept at the branch warehouse past the free storage period are billed one storage fee on the order. Billable days stop on the day installation starts or the order is cancelled. The storage fee is fixed only after the order carries the on-time guarantee credit it has earned whenever its shipment came in later than the guarantee grace period allows.

## The waiting condition, restated

Where the order's shipment came in later than its guarantee grace period allows, the storage fee is fixed only once the on-time guarantee credit the order has earned stands on the order's milestone records.

## Business effect

| Item | After billing |
|---|---|
| Milestone records | one storage fee charge, dated the billing day, with the billable storage weeks and the units on the order |
| Order-level charges the customer owes | increased by the storage fee |

## The billing tool: `assess_branch_storage_97307cec`

**Capability.** The tool bills the storage fee for delivered units of a factory production order kept at the branch warehouse. One call records one storage fee charge on the order dated today, with the fee, the billable storage weeks and the units on the order, and adds it to the order-level charges the customer owes. Afterwards the charge is listed among the order's milestone records.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_branch_storage_97307cec` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `factory_order_id` | the reference number of the factory production order whose units were stored, as returned by the factory order lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `fee_amount` | the storage fee in USD | positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `billable_weeks` | the billable storage weeks the fee covers | whole non-negative integer count |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt with `status` (`charged` on success), `order_milestone_id` (the reference number of the storage charge), `factory_order_id` (the order charged), `charge_kind` (always `storage_fee`), `charge_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), `week_count` (billable weeks, an integer), `unit_count` (units on the order, an integer) and `amount` (the fee in USD, 2 decimal places).
